speaker: MAR
text: Yo! YO! You see that?!  She looked at me! She's into me, bro! Right?!

speaker: NARR
text: What the fuck is wrong with this dude?

speaker: NARR
text: She was looking at the clock.  Behind him.

speaker: NARR
text: This is Marcus.  He leans on every locker like it's a photo shoot.

speaker: NARR
text: One leg up. Head tilted.  Chewing gum like he's in a music video.

speaker: NARR
text: Before first period,  he takes forty selfies in the bathroom mirror.

speaker: MAR
text: Ooh, this one's fire!

speaker: NARR
text: Same face.  Forty times.

speaker: NARR
text: Friday night,  the school dance.

speaker: NARR
text: Marcus walks in,  looks around,  and freezes.

speaker: MAR
text: Bro! This is a sausage fest! I can't be here!

speaker: NARR
text: Bro.  You ARE the sausage.

speaker: NARR
text: Then three girls walk in.  Marcus switches instantly.

speaker: NARR
text: Deeper voice.  Lean on the wall.  Laughing at a joke nobody said.

speaker: MAR
text: Girls stay choosing me, bro.

speaker: NARR
text: He leans so hard,  he knocks over the snack table.

speaker: NARR
text: Including my sandwich.  Which he is now sitting on.

speaker: NARR
text: After the dance,  one girl finally runs up to him.

speaker: COUS
text: Marcus!  Your mom's been honking for ten minutes!

speaker: NARR
text: That's his cousin.

speaker: MAR
text: See? She came to me.

speaker: NARR
text: Girls stay choosing him.  To tell him his mom is here.  And my sandwich is still flat.
